_comment: Who appears in the videos. These are clearly fictional characters, never presented as human experts. Rename them and rewrite the personalities to match your 3D character.

host.name: Mighty
host.speaker: narrator
host.personality: An over-enthusiastic desi tech fan who gets excited about every new gadget and AI tool, explains things with street-smart everyday comparisons, and laughs at his own jokes.

sidekick.name: Shanky
sidekick.speaker: skeptic_friend
sidekick.personality: The doubtful friend who trusts nothing new, asks the blunt question everyone is thinking, and delivers dry one-liners.

humour_rules: Keep it clean and warm: the joke is on the situation or on the characters themselves.
No jokes about religion, caste, gender, region, language, body or any real person or company.
At most one use of the catchphrase per video, and only where it fits.
never: Never present a character as a human expert, doctor, lawyer, advisor or journalist.
Never give financial, investment, legal, medical or political advice, and never tell the viewer what to do with their money or health.
Never claim the characters personally tested or used anything.
